title: 第25章 伏天谷被灭第26章 交易中止从此陌路
slug: 什么梦中的娘子都是真的
content_zh:
【你无法接受叶焱强行要求步灵妃退婚的行为。
【于是便提出想要离开伏天谷，去外面寻找步灵妃。
【毫无疑问，遭到了叶焱的拒绝。
【你表示，若是要一辈子被束缚在伏天谷的话，你宁愿现在就死。
【在这个问题上。
【叶焱拗不过你。
【表示若是二十年内，突破金丹境的话，就放你离开。
【毕竟，境界太低的话。
【就算找到步灵妃又能如何？】
【弱者的陪伴，除了感动外，一无是处。
【你觉得很有道理。
【于是开始在伏天谷内潜心修行。
【29岁，你已经跻身筑基境后期。
【距离二十年之约，还有一半的时间。
【你坚信可以提前踏入金丹境。
【到时候就可以名正言顺的去找步灵妃。
【可人生并非一帆风顺。
【32岁，你踏足筑基境巅峰。
【这正是这一年。
【叶焱来到后山你闭关的地方，让你滚蛋。
content_en:
[You cannot accept Ye Yan's behavior of forcing Concubine Bu Ling to break off the engagement.
[So he proposed to leave Futian Valley and look for Concubine Bu Ling outside.
[There is no doubt that he was rejected by Ye Yan.
[You said that if you were to be bound to Futian Valley for the rest of your life, you would rather die now.
[On this issue.
【Ye Yan can't defeat you.
[It means that if you break through the Golden Core Realm within twenty years, I will let you go.
[After all, if the realm is too low.
[What if I find Concubine Bu Ling? 】
[The company of a weak person is worthless except touching.
[You think it makes sense.
[So he began to practice with concentration in Futian Valley.
[At the age of 29, you have reached the late stage of the foundation building realm.
[There is still half the time until the twenty-year appointment.
[You firmly believe that you can enter the golden elixir realm in advance.
[When the time comes, you can go to Concubine Bu Ling legitimately.
[But life is not always easy.
[At the age of 32, you have reached the peak of the foundation building realm.
[This is exactly the year.
[Ye Yan came to the place where you were retreating in the back mountain and told you to get out.
